item.title: H.S. WRESTLING: Tri-Valley falls in state tournament to Conwell-Egan despite valiant effort
item.description: SCHUYLKILL HAVEN — Despite a valiant effort against an undefeated Conwell-Egan team, the Tri-Valley Bulldogs’ team dual season came to an end on Tuesday evening at the CACL Center at Schuylkill Haven High School. The Bulldogs fell to the Eagles 46-24 in the preliminary round of the PIAA Class AA Team Wrestling championships.
